title: Monsoon House

languages.notes: source dialogue is English; two dialect subtitle tracks (Hindi, Kannada) are supplied for regional campaigns

setting: A small coastal-plain town in Karnataka, monsoon season

characters.name: Anand Iyer
characters.notes: under financial pressure from his firm's dues

characters.name: Lakshmi
characters.role: maternal aunt; has run the house for 30 years

characters.name: Ravi
characters.notes: left ten years ago; returns unannounced

characters.name: Suresh
characters.notes: assumed by the family to be the house's enemy

characters.name: Shobha
characters.role: neighbor; runs the village feast committee

relationships.relation: siblings in conflict over the house
childhood friends, estranged for ten years

protected_facts.text: Mother sold the land years ago to shield the family from debt; the house was never legally theirs.
Suresh was mother's ally; he has been guarding the deed all along.
